newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia eyes additional $300 mln in debt issues.
newsitem.headline: Colombia eyes additional $300 mln in debt issues.

text.p: Colombia plan to issue an additional $300 million in sovereign debt this year, Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo said.
He said the government was eyeing Europe as the best market to tap for the new issuance, but did not specify how soon the bonds might be placed there.

Colombia has issued a total of $1.08 billion in sovereign debt in the United States, Europe and Japan this year, but Ocampo, who spoke in an interview with Reuter, said he had absolutely no concerns about overexposure or excessive risk.
"We've totally covered ourselves against any foreign exchange risk," he said.
"As a rule, we maintain a composition of risks so that, if there are losses (on the foreign exchange side) they are compensated by earnings obtained through international reserves," he said.
